ax.txt_id_eligible: Large dragon footprints adorn the entrance to the cave.\nAre you really sure, you want to enter?
Gnawed bones lie in the cave entrance.\n\nEnter?

ax.text_id: The hut is empty, except a single table with a shiny scale on it. Next to it is a sign: “Put the money on the table and become bargainers!”.

ax.txt_id_eligible: Witchcraft symbols are drawn all over the cave entrance.\n\nDo you want to enter?
It is strangely silent around the dungeon. Also from inside there is absolutely no noise.\n\nEnter the Fortress of Fear?
ax.txt_id_not_eligible: The entrance of the Fortress of Fear has a golden lock. You need the orange key to enter.

ax.txt_id_eligible: It is strangely silent around the dungeon. Also from inside there is absolutely no noise.\n\nEnter the Fortress of Fear?

ax.txt_id_eligible: The unmistakable aura of death hangs thick as a blanket on the door.\nEnter?
ax.txt_id_not_eligible: The tomb is sealed. It looks like you need a black key to proceed.

ax.txt_id_eligible: A red shield is fixed to the door.\nEnter the Dark Warrior’s Keep?
ax.txt_id_not_eligible: A red shield is fixed to the door. The door is locked and you are missing the key.

ax.txt_id_eligible: Small wisps of smoke make their way through the door.\nDo you want to go through?
ax.txt_id_not_eligible: You don't have the green key to enter.

ax.txt_id_eligible: The entrance is surrounded by strange little statues depicting birds, insects, and snakes.\n\nEnter the dungeon?
ax.txt_id_not_eligible: The entrance is surrounded by strange little statues depicting birds, insects, and snakes. There is a golden keyhole, but you have no matching key.

ax.txt_id_eligible: A sharp crackling sound can be heard, and the smell of burning pervades the dungeon entrance. \n\nEnter?
ax.txt_id_not_eligible: There is a blue lock on the dungeon door and you do not have the fitting key.

ax.text_id: The crow is sitting on its bird perch. Quickly her head moves to the left, then slowly back at you. This intelligent creature certainly is aware of its environment and its dangers.\nAllow the crow to follow you?

The orb hovers in the forest, emitting a soothing glow. You feel a magical aura coming from it. Although you are not quite sure what “it” actually is, it seems it is willing to help you.\nTry to have the orb follow you?
A smile appears, when the fairy sees you. “My heroes, my saivors, you returned. Let me join you and I will use my abilities to increase your elemental resistances.”.\nAccept the fairy’s offer?
The majestic wolf looks you right into your eyes and you keep a respectful distance. You are fully aware of the its fighting strength.\nInvite the wolf into your party to fight alongside you?

This has got to be the friendliest donkey, you have ever seen. He gently nudges his head against you and let’s you pet him. He also does not seem to mind carrying things around.\nAdopt this pet into your group?

ax.txt_id_eligible: The banner of the Chaotic Balance flutters in the wind, high above the gates of Bloodreign Castle.\n\nEnter?
Cold air comes from the entrance of the cavern, which leads deep under the desert.\n\nEnter?
A foul stench is coming from the cave. Enter anyway?
